summary: Comprehensive testing of MeetFlow - ALL features tested. 42/42 backend API tests passed. Frontend UI verified across all pages. All major features working: Auth, Meetings CRUD, Schedule Polls, General Polls, 1:1 Booking, Recordings, Admin, Analytics, Calendar, Profile, Translations.

minor.issue: Returns 'booking_by_day' instead of 'bookings' key - minor naming inconsistency

issues: Missing 'Zusammenfassung' (Summary) option - has 'Code kopieren' instead. May be intentional design choice.

passed_tests: AUTH: POST /api/auth/login with correct credentials returns user + sets cookies
AUTH: POST /api/auth/login with wrong password returns 401
AUTH: GET /api/auth/me without cookies returns 401
AUTH: POST /api/auth/register creates new user
MEETINGS: POST /api/meetings creates instant meeting (meeting_type=instant)
MEETINGS: POST /api/meetings creates scheduled meeting with scheduled_at
MEETINGS: GET /api/meetings returns paginated results with {meetings, total, page, pages}
MEETINGS: GET /api/meetings?search=Team filters by title
MEETINGS: GET /api/meetings?meeting_type=upcoming returns only upcoming
MEETINGS: PUT /api/meetings/{id} updates meeting title/description/date
MEETINGS: DELETE /api/meetings/{id} removes meeting
MEETINGS: GET /api/meetings/{id}/ical returns valid .ics file
SCHEDULE POLLS: POST /api/schedule-polls creates poll with time_slots
SCHEDULE POLLS: GET /api/schedule-polls/public/{token} returns poll without auth
SCHEDULE POLLS: POST .../vote records vote, same voter name updates existing vote
SCHEDULE POLLS: POST .../comment adds comment
SCHEDULE POLLS: POST .../suggest adds time slot (when allowed)
SCHEDULE POLLS: POST /api/schedule-polls/{id}/confirm confirms slot and creates meeting
SCHEDULE POLLS: GET /api/schedule-polls/{id}/export/csv returns CSV
SCHEDULE POLLS: GET /api/schedule-polls/{id}/export/pdf returns PDF

GENERAL POLLS: POST /api/general-polls creates poll with single/multiple type

BOOKING: GET /api/booking/availability returns weekday schedule
BOOKING: PUT /api/booking/availability saves settings (weekdays, duration, buffer, blocked_dates)
